summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice to shareholders regarding the payment of Interest on Capital (IoC). The Board of Directors approved payments on August 28, 2026, for amounts previously announced in Material Facts dated February 26, 2026 (BRL 3.85 billion total, BRL 0.34888 gross per share) and May 28, 2026 (BRL 3.99 billion total, BRL 0.36188 gross per share). The payments are made equally to holders of common (ITUB3) and preferred (ITUB4) shares, subject to 17.5% withholding tax. This is a routine dividend distribution notice, not a special situation. No deal terms, advisors, or strategic actions are involved; the event is a standard capital return through periodic interest on equity payments.
